2	name: stdo-work
3	description: Execute or coordinate one admitted STDO work item through its lawful re-entry point. Use for STDO requirements, design, code or test work, including issuing bounded work to a separate Worker. Do not invoke for generic non-STDO development.
4	---
5	
6	# STDO Work
7	
8	Deliver the smallest causally closed change authorized by one exact work basis.
9	The admitted re-entry point decides where work begins.
10	
11	## Start With Your Own Control Intake
12	
13	Read the exact own contract or intake named in the request before any general
14	search or project read. Bind your own permitted inputs, exclusions and return
15	route, then apply [Control Intake](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#control-intake).
16	This applies to issuer, recipient and direct work. Use named control routes;
17	do not start with directory inventories, memory searches or neighbouring
18	prompts. A Worker’s access never becomes its issuer’s access. Check the actual
19	host boundary before relying on excluded information staying unavailable.
20	
21	## Choose The Entry
22	
23	If receiving a coordinated packet, apply
24	[Receive](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#receive) before the general
25	discovery, classification or subject reads below. After validation, use this
26	skill's ordinary procedure within that packet; return its closed work result
27	through the named surface and consumer, then stop.
28	
29	If the active frame coordinates this work across a material boundary, use
30	[Issue](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#issue). Select the authorized
31	unit from its existing carrier, bind the Worker additions of
32	`EXECUTIVE_BASELINE` §19 and dispatch a recipient of this same skill. The
33	issuer consumes [the return](../../references/COORDINATED_HANDOFF.md#evaluate-the-return)
34	under §12 steps 3–4 and determines required review; it does not fall through
35	into construction in its Executive frame. If the grant requires another
36	actor, a same-actor role change is insufficient.
37	
38	Otherwise follow the direct path below. A sufficient direct Writer invocation
39	needs no added coordinator, Worker, ticket or review. The accepted frame basis
40	and actual authority decide; the requested mode alone grants nothing.
41	
42	## Select The Product Basis
43	
44	Read and apply
45	[`PRODUCT_BASIS.md`](../../references/PRODUCT_BASIS.md) before drafting an
46	execution contract or changing any surface. Continue only from its exactly-one
47	verified selection; that selection grants no work or mutation authority.
48	
49	## Acquire The Deciding Owners
50	
51	Enter through the verified definition's declared bootstrap entrypoint. Then
